meta.title: GenAI at work — validation of the extraction
meta.tagline: The pipeline's record of each paper checked by coders in three passes: a blind judgment of design and units by two coders, one exhibit's cells against the print, every routed flag resolved.
meta.description: One workflow over the three validation presets of the GenAI-at-work review: the pipeline's record of every paper enters as import files with the PDF (the quoted passages highlighted), and coders check it in three passes, each in a dataset of its own. Judgment: the study's screening and design from the PDF alone, the units as extracted (tasks, arms, outcomes, subgroups, horizons) with the coder's categories, the abstract's sentences against their units — two coders per paper. Extraction check: one exhibit per paper, drawn at random by the pipeline, every cited cell as printed against its unit, misses added, a full-review flag. Routed papers: a paper whose record contradicts an inclusion criterion, whose headline estimate scores high on the checks, or that a coder flagged — every flag resolved by a coder. The coders are added by email to the workflow dataset; each paper of a pass is assigned to its coders, who code it independently; the release waits for every assigned verdict.

steps.label: Extraction record
steps.help: the pipeline's record of the paper — the tasks with their arms and outcomes, one reference row and one contrast row per estimate with the numbers as printed, the claims of its text, its exhibits with their transcribed cells, the flags its checks raised and its routing — uploaded with the PDF; not reviewed, checked below

steps.label: Judgment
steps.help: the study's screening and design from the PDF alone, the units as extracted with the coder's categories, the abstract's sentences against their units

steps.label: Extraction check
steps.help: one exhibit per paper, drawn at random by the pipeline: every cited cell as printed against its unit, the cells the extraction missed added, a full-review flag

steps.label: Routed papers
steps.help: a paper whose record contradicts an inclusion criterion, whose headline estimate scores high on the checks, or that a coder flagged: every flag listed

steps.label: Record checks
steps.help: the pipeline's deterministic checks over the record as stored: structure, plausibility and scale, statistics within the rounding, SD vs SE, duplicates, numbers against their quotes; findings are notes on the records, the routing stays the pipeline's

steps.label: Contract check (judgment)
steps.help: the declared fields, types and options of the pass re-checked on the values as stored, after the coders' corrections; findings are notes on the records, never a verdict

steps.label: Contract check (extraction check)
steps.help: the declared fields, types and options of the pass re-checked on the values as stored, after the coders' corrections; findings are notes on the records, never a verdict

steps.label: Contract check (routed papers)
steps.help: the declared fields, types and options of the pass re-checked on the values as stored, after the coders' corrections; findings are notes on the records, never a verdict

steps.label: Judgment by two coders
steps.help: every judgment paper coded whole by two coders, each blind to the other, in a coding of their own

steps.label: Extraction check by one coder
steps.help: every extraction-check paper coded whole by one coder: value and mapping cell by cell, misses added, a full-review flag

steps.label: Routed papers resolved by one coder
steps.help: every routed paper coded whole by one coder: each flag resolved
